pages.title: Dawn Verdict
pages.text: §lCrafting: §r Smithing Table: Dawn Template + Bow + Iron Ingot.$(br2)§lAmmo: §r Only Dawn Arrows (8 Arrows + Torch → 8 Dawn Arrows). Fired Dawn Arrows can be recovered.$(br2)§lStats: §r 5000 durability; full draw in 1.25s, 40 damage (20 hearts) at full draw; arrow speed is double vanilla.$(br2)§lBuilt-in enchantments: §r Power XII, Flame, Experience Gift, Smite XII, Looting XII, Made in China, Dawn.

pages.title: Extra Abilities
pages.text: §lVerdict Lightning: §r 20% chance on hit to deal 40 additional sourced void damage.$(br2)§lDawnfall: §r ×2.5 damage to undead, ×3.4 damage to bosses.
